segments.title: Arrival Warm-Up
segments.diagramNote: Kids arrive, grab a ball, free play in a 20x15 yard space. Loose touches, get moving before we start.
checklist: Set up 20x15 yard space with cones
Kids get a ball and free-play as they arrive

segments.title: Welcome & Team Chat
segments.diagramNote: Quick chat: what we did last time, what we're doing today. Keep it under 5 minutes — kids are ready to move.
checklist: Welcome players, quick theme of the day

segments.title: Red Light, Green Light with Ball
segments.diagramNote: 20x15 yard grid. Each player has a ball. Green = dribble fast, Yellow = dribble slow. On Red: stop the ball with your sole, or OPT to do toe taps while moving the ball forward (their choice). Mix it up and keep calls unpredictable.
checklist: Set up 20x15 yard grid, each player has a ball
Green = fast dribble, Yellow = slow dribble
Red = stop with sole, or opt to toe-tap the ball forward
Mix calls, keep feet moving the whole time
segments.notesPlaceholder: e.g. who got the toe-tap option, call frequency...
